espaces.connexion.ailleurs: You do not have access to the space “{ici}”: you are now in the space “{la}”.
espaces.erreur.base_existante: A database already exists for the address /espace/{code}/ (from an old space). Choose another code, or ask your IT team to remove this database.
espaces.erreur.code: Address code: 2 to 20 lowercase letters without accents or digits, starting with a letter (for example “purchasing”).
espaces.erreur.code_pris: A space already uses the address /espace/{code}/. Choose another code.
espaces.erreur.code_reserve: The code “{code}” is reserved by the tool: choose another one.
espaces.erreur.creation: The space could not be created: {erreur}
espaces.erreur.deja_cree: This space has already been created.
espaces.erreur.indisponible: The space “{nom}” is temporarily unavailable. Tell your IT team: the startup log gives the cause.
espaces.erreur.interrompue: The creation of the space stopped ({erreur}). The space stays “Being created”. To finish it, click “Resume creation” in the list of spaces.
espaces.erreur.nom_long: The space name must not exceed {max} characters.
espaces.erreur.nom_pris: A space is already called “{nom}”. Choose another name.
espaces.erreur.nom_vide: Enter a name for the space (for example “Purchasing”).
espaces.erreur.soi_meme: You cannot remove this right from yourself or block your own sign-in.
espaces.liste.aide: Each space has its own data: frameworks, organisations, campaigns, values, evidence, and identity. Accounts are shared: a person signs in once.
espaces.liste.archive: Space “{nom}” archived. It is hidden from everyone, and its data is kept.
espaces.liste.archiver_confirmer: Archive the space “{nom}”? It is hidden from everyone. Its data is kept, and you can reactivate it.
espaces.liste.sauvegardes: Each space has its own backups (Settings › Hosting in that space). You cannot delete a space: archive it to hide it. The tool keeps its data.
espaces.nouveau.aide: A space is for another department or another use (for example “Purchasing”). It starts empty. You are its administrator, and the setup wizard opens at once.
espaces.nouveau.attente: Creating the space: a few seconds…
espaces.nouveau.code_aide: The address of the space is /espace/<code>/: 2 to 20 lowercase letters without accents or digits. The tool suggests a code from the name. You cannot change it after creation.
espaces.nouveau.cree: Space “{nom}” created. You are its administrator, and the setup starts now.
espaces.nouveau.identite: Reuse the identity (organisation name, colours, logo) of the current space
espaces.nouveau.nom_aide: Shown in the button of the top bar that changes space. You can edit it later.
espaces.pas_acces.aide: To access it, ask an administrator of this space.
espaces.pas_acces.titre: You do not have access to the space “{nom}”
espaces.personnes.aide: The role of each person in each space. To give access to a space, open it, then go to Administration › Accounts.
espaces.personnes.bloquer_confirmer: Block sign-in for {nom} in all spaces? Their accounts and history are kept.
espaces.personnes.bloquer_nom: Block sign-in for {nom} in all spaces
espaces.personnes.retire: {nom} is no longer a space manager.
espaces.personnes.retirer: Remove the right to manage spaces from {nom}
espaces.refus_identite: This account is also used in another space: only an administrator of all its spaces, or a space manager, can change its identity or password.
espaces.liste.aide_bouton: To change space, use the button with the name of the space, in the top bar. It appears as soon as you have access to two spaces.
espaces.personnes.aide_droits: A space manager creates and manages the spaces. A sign-in blocked here is blocked in all spaces.
espaces.erreur.dernier_gestionnaire: {nom} is the last space manager who can act. Appoint another space manager first.
espaces.erreur.archive_dernier_gestionna: This space has the only active account of the last space manager who can act. Appoint another space manager first.
espaces.erreur.pas_admin_principal: {nom} cannot be a space manager: only an active administrator of the main space can be one.
